t: This is Chapel Street, in Belgravia. It runs south-west to north-east, from Belgrave Square down to Grosvenor Place. It's a short, quiet connection between those two points. The genealogist Hervey Charles Pechell, born in 1841, died on this street in 1898. The material I have is brief, so that is the main thing to say about the street's history.
